lecture_title: Quantum Logic, Measurement, and Vector Spaces

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: The two slits and completed interference profile are clear and unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: You find what's called an interference pattern.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: The full three-state directed cycle is unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Whenever you have heads, it goes to tails. Whenever you have tails, it goes to feet.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: Both broad momentum profiles and their displacement are simultaneously visible.
assets.caption_hint: plate momentum distribution before and after recoil
assets.subtitle_excerpt: It shifts this probability distribution a small amount.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Photon energy, momentum-wavelength, wave speed, and image-resolution relations are visible together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The momentum is equal to Planck's constant divided by lambda.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: The incoming photon, localized object, and possible scattering directions are visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The high momentum photon may make a very good image of the position, but then it's going to collide with this.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Both coarse position readings and the velocity estimate are complete.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The sloppiness of the velocity measurement is lambda divided by t.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Ket addition and a general complex linear combination are readable.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: You can take any pair of vectors, multiply both of them by arbitrary complex numbers, add them, and you get a new vector.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: Complex-function decomposition and function addition are visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: If psi and phi are complex functions, their sum is a complex function.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: Componentwise column addition and scalar multiplication are complete and unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Just add the entries. This is the definition of adding of column vectors.

assets.name: lecture_01_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: The complex-conjugate product and squared magnitude are unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: z star z is x squared plus y squared.
